newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wool prices mixed at Christchurch sale.
newsitem.headline: Wool prices mixed at Christchurch sale.

text.p: Wool prices were mixed at a Christchurch wool sale on Thursday, Wools of New Zealand said.
The market indicator fell one cent to NZ$4.67. The medium segment indicator rose six to $5.03, the strong segment fell one to $4.30 and the fine segment fell 10 to $8.20.
Principal interest came from Western Europe and China with support from Japan, Nepal and local mills.

Some 10 percent of the 1,141 tonnes on offer was passed in. The sale comprised 39 percent merino fleece, 20 percent halfbred fleece, 11 percent bulky skirtings with the balance made up of miscellaneous wools.
Compared with the Dunedin sale a week ago merino fleece varied from two percent cheaper to two percent dearer.
Halfbred was generally unchanged and bulky skirtings up to two percent dearer. Crossbred fleece was unchanged as were the other wools.
The next sales are at Christchurch and Napier on November 7.
